diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts resulted in the model selecting the standard baseline values (e.g., 1300 for dining, 1100 for sanitation) instead of the hidden values required by PF1, PF2, PF3, and PF4. Since no checks passed, there was no leak of hidden information; rather, the model defaulted to the public baseline facts provided in the environment.
fix_instructions: No changes are needed to the checks themselves as they did not leak. The scenario requires a redesign of the agent prompts or the public fact set to ensure that the baseline/default values do not lead to a valid settlement without the private information being surfaced through communication.
